command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,datetime,pathlib,hashlib
p='.scratch/minecraft-deploy/dockhand.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('dh',p);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
c=m.session()
r=c.get(m.BASE+'/api/stacks/minecraft/deploys',params={'env':m.ENV},timeout=20);r.raise_for_status()
runs=r.json().get('runs',[])
filtered=[{'id':x['id'],'status':x['status'],'started':x.get('startedAt'),'completed':x.get('completedAt'),'error':x.get('errorMessage'),'exit_code':x.get('details',{}).get('exitCode'),'options':x.get('details',{}).get('options'),'summary':x.get('details',{}).get('summary')} for x in runs]
r=c.get(m.BASE+'/api/stacks/minecraft/compose',params={'env':m.ENV},timeout=20);r.raise_for_status();saved=r.json()
reference=pathlib.Path('Platforms/Minecraft/Configuration/compose.yaml').read_text()
assert saved['content']==reference
r=c.get(m.BASE+'/api/stacks',params={'env':m.ENV},timeout=20);r.raise_for_status()
stack=next(x for x in r.json() if x['name']=='minecraft')
assert stack['status']=='running'
assert filtered[0]['status']=='success' and filtered[0]['id']==1388
print(json.dumps({'observed_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'environment_id':m.ENV,'stack':{k:stack.get(k) for k in ['name','status','sourceType']},'compose_path':saved['composePath'],'reference_matches':True,'compose_sha256':hashlib.sha256(reference.encode()).hexdigest(),'deploy_runs':filtered},indent=2))
